plans.title: Recommended Core Plan: Mon Feb 22 – Mon Mar 1, 2027 (7 Nights)
plans.subtitle: Lowest surge-free hotel week · Catches Bryant Park Winter Village before Feb 28 close · Off-Peak Wollman Rink · Zero backtracking
plans.baseHotelRecommendation: Artezen Hotel (FiDi — $1,127 pre-tax free-cancel) OR Cambria Hotel Chelsea ($1,364–$1,522 ALL-IN, $0 resort fee)

days.zone: Midtown East & Bryant Park Winter Village
days.morning: Arrive NYC & drop bags at hotel. Tap your contactless card/phone for OMNY ($3/ride — starts your 7-day $35/pp cap!).
days.afternoon: Explore Grand Central Terminal (FREE) + NYPL Schwarzman Building (open Mon 10 AM–6 PM; FREE) → Skate or grab hot chocolate at Bank of America Winter Village at Bryant Park (CLOSES Sun Feb 28!).
days.evening: Sunset at SUMMIT One Vanderbilt (indoor climate-controlled!) → Cozy Michelin Bib Gourmand dinner at Tonchin NYC ($56–$95 for 2) OR 2★ Pre-Theater at Gabriel Kreuther ($310).
days.transitNote: All stops sit along a single 4-block 42nd Street corridor (4/5/6/7/B/D/F/M).

days.theme: Lady Liberty, Brooklyn Bridge & FiDi 60th-Floor Views
days.morning: 9:30 AM Statue City Cruises ferry from Battery Park to Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island ($52/couple all-in; avoid street touts!).
days.afternoon: Walk across the Brooklyn Bridge to DUMBO waterfront & Time Out Market (FREE) → Return via subway or ride the FREE Staten Island Ferry at dusk!
days.evening: 60th-floor sunset cocktails/dinner at Manhatta Bar (walk-in, ~$95–$150) OR 1★ Crown Shy ($140–$220) — OR splurge on 2★ Saga (note: Saga opens Wed–Sun, so swap Saga to Wed/Thu if chosen!).
days.transitNote: 100% clustered in Lower Manhattan / FiDi (walkable from Artezen Hotel; 15 min on 1/2/3/4/5 from Midtown/Chelsea).

days.theme: Modern Art, 2★ Sculpture Garden Lunch & Broadway Night
days.morning: 10:30 AM opening at MoMA ($60/couple; Note: The Met is CLOSED Wednesdays, making Wed the ideal MoMA day!).
days.afternoon: 12:30 PM 2★ Michelin 3-course lunch at The Modern overlooking MoMA's Sculpture Garden ($230/couple) → Stroll Rockefeller Center & Top of the Rock ($84–$142) OR skip deck if doing Edge/SUMMIT.
days.evening: Hit TKTS Times Square (opens Wed 11 AM for matinee/evening!) or Lincoln Center booth for 30–50% off Broadway show ($120–$260 for 2) → Post-show nightcap!
days.transitNote: 53rd St → 50th St → 47th St — completely walkable 10-block Midtown stretch!

days.zone: Chelsea, Hudson Yards & Flatiron Michelin Hub
days.theme: Elevated Park, Food Hall & Korea-Meets-NYC Fine Dining
days.morning: 10:00 AM Advance Saver slot at Edge Hudson Yards ($72/couple when booked 14+ days out) → Walk south along The High Line (winter hours 7 AM–7 PM; FREE).
days.afternoon: Warm up indoors at Chelsea Market (FREE entry; Los Tacos No. 1 / pastries ~$35) → Browse Flatiron District & Madison Square Park.
days.evening: 1★ Michelin Korean BBQ date night at COTE Butcher's Feast® ($168/couple) OR splurge on 2★ Atomix ($628–$848) or 3★ Eleven Madison Park ($450–$770) — all within 8 blocks!
days.transitNote: 7 train to Hudson Yards → walk south on High Line → crosstown to Flatiron (zero wasted rides!).

days.zone: Central Park, Upper East Side & Midtown 3★ Flagship
days.theme: 3★ Weekday Lunch Deal + Extended Friday Evening at The Met
days.morning: Off-Peak/Peak skate at Wollman Rink in Central Park (10 AM opening; $56–$80/couple incl. skates) + walk Gapstow Bridge & Bethesda Terrace (FREE).
days.afternoon: 12:30 PM 3★ Michelin 3-course weekday lunch at Le Bernardin ($284/couple — NYC's ultimate 3-star value!) → Head up 5th Ave to The Met.
days.evening: Extended Friday evening at The Met (open till 9:00 PM! $60/couple; sunset at Temple of Dendur + Great Hall cocktails) → Late Night Jazz at Dizzy's Club (10:45 PM set, $30/couple cover!).
days.transitNote: Central Park South → W 51st St → 4/5/6 or M1–M4 bus up Fifth Ave → Columbus Circle.

days.zone: SoHo, West Village & Lower East Side
days.theme: Cast-Iron Stroll, Iconic Deli & Village Showstopper
days.morning: Brunch/early pastrami feast at Katz's Delicatessen (Bib Gourmand, open 24 hrs Fri–Sun! $65–$90/couple) before peak lunch lines.
days.afternoon: Explore SoHo cast-iron galleries & Greenwich Village brownstones → Optional 1★ Le Coucou 2-course lunch ($162) if skipping Katz's morning.
days.evening: 1★ Semma ($130–$210, set alarm 15 days out 9 AM EST!) OR Bib Gourmand Bungalow ($100–$150) OR Selected icons Carbone ($175–$320) / Minetta Tavern ($120–$220).
days.transitNote: Walkable Downtown triangle (LES → SoHo → West Village) served by F/M, 6, A/C/E, 1.

days.morning: 9:30 AM 9/11 Memorial & Museum (open Sun 9 AM–7 PM; $72/couple, warm indoor museum) + Calatrava Oculus.
days.afternoon: Take the L train across the East River to Williamsburg, Brooklyn — explore Bedford Ave, vintage boutiques & waterfront skyline views (or AMNH on UWS, $74/couple).
days.evening: Farewell dinner: Brooklyn's 2★ Aska ($750) OR 1★ The Four Horsemen (unverified à la carte) OR Laser Wolf heated rooftop skyline dinner — OR Manhattan farewell at 2★ Saga (63rd fl, $430) / 3★ Jungsik ($670) / Bib Coqodaq ($104)!
days.transitNote: Last day of your 7-day $35/pp OMNY cap — every subway ride today is effectively FREE!

plans.title: Alternative Plan: Mon Feb 15 – Mon Feb 22, 2027 (7 Nights)
plans.subtitle: Captures the 29th Chinatown Lunar New Year Parade (Sun Feb 21) + Lowest Arlo SoHo ($1,021) & Club Quarters ($1,113) rates
plans.baseHotelRecommendation: Arlo SoHo ($1,021 pre-tax BF) OR Club Quarters Grand Central ($1,113 pre-tax BF) OR Artezen ($1,168 free-cancel)

days.theme: Dodge Holiday Crowds with Open Landmarks & Cozy Dinner
days.morning: Arrive & check in. Note: NYPL Schwarzman Building typically closes on Presidents' Day & Wollman Rink runs holiday Peak pricing — save both for later in the week!
days.afternoon: Walk Central Park (FREE) & explore Grand Central Terminal (open 365 days) → Afternoon reservation at MoMA ($60, open daily).
days.evening: Dinner at COTE 1★ ($168) or Coqodaq Bib Gourmand ($104) — both open Mondays (unlike Jungsik, Sushi Sho, Atomix, Saga, Aska & Bungalow!).
days.transitNote: Crucial Monday scheduling rule: 6 of our 27 curated Michelin spots close Mondays — pick COTE, Le Bernardin, EMP, The Modern, Gramercy Tavern, or Coqodaq!

days.theme: NYPL Reading Room + Bryant Park Ice + SUMMIT
days.morning: 10:00 AM NYPL Rose Main Reading Room public visiting hour (FREE) → Ice skate Bryant Park Winter Village ($37–$129 rental or $0 own skates).
days.afternoon: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt ($91+) + lunch at Tonchin NYC Bib Gourmand ($56 weekday lunch set!).
days.evening: 3★ Jungsik (reopens Tuesdays! $670) OR 2★ Aquavit ($390) OR Broadway via TKTS (Tue 3 PM booth opening).

days.morning: Statue City Cruises ($52 all-in) to Liberty & Ellis Islands (morning slot before 3:30 PM winter cutoff).
days.evening: 2★ Saga on the 63rd floor (opens Wed–Sun! $430) OR 1★ Crown Shy ($140–$220) + Manhatta 60th-floor bar nightcap.

days.theme: Edge Deck, High Line, Chelsea Market & Village Legend
days.morning: Edge Hudson Yards ($72 Advance Saver) → High Line winter walk (FREE) → Chelsea Market lunch.
days.afternoon: West Village brownstone stroll & cozy coffee stops.
days.evening: 1★ Semma ($130–$210) OR Minetta Tavern ($120–$220) OR Carbone ($175–$320).
days.transitNote: 7 train to Hudson Yards → walk south into Chelsea & West Village.

days.theme: 3★ Le Bernardin Lunch + Friday Night at The Met + Jazz
days.morning: Stroll 5th Ave & Central Park South (FREE) + Top of the Rock ($84–$142).
days.afternoon: 3★ Le Bernardin weekday lunch ($284/couple) → Head uptown to The Met.
days.evening: The Met extended Friday hours until 9:00 PM ($60) → Dizzy's Club Late Night Jazz (10:45 PM, $30).

days.theme: Brooklyn Bridge Crossing, DUMBO & Brooklyn Michelin
days.morning: Walk Brooklyn Bridge to DUMBO & Brooklyn Bridge Park (FREE) + Time Out Market coffee/lunch.
days.afternoon: Ferry or subway north to Williamsburg for shopping & craft coffee (optional: Queens' 1★ Meju 1 stop from Grand Central, $470–$564!).
days.evening: Williamsburg dinner at 2★ Aska ($750) OR 1★ The Four Horsemen OR Laser Wolf heated skyline roof.
days.transitNote: Brooklyn Bridge → L/G or NYC Ferry to Williamsburg.

days.theme: 29th Chinatown Lunar New Year Parade & Iconic NYC Finale
days.morning: Early pastrami & matzo ball soup at Katz's Deli ($65–$90) OR 1★ Le Coucou SoHo lunch ($162).
days.afternoon: 1:00 PM — 29th Chinatown Lunar New Year Parade & Festival (FREE! Mott St & Canal St → Sara D. Roosevelt Park; dragon/lion dances, confetti & street food!).
days.evening: Farewell dinner at Bib Gourmand Dhamaka ($110–$170) or Bungalow ($100–$150) — OR Sunday-open 3★ Per Se ($850) / 3★ Eleven Madison Park ($450–$770)!
days.transitNote: Chinatown/SoHo/LES completely walkable (5–10 min from Arlo SoHo or Artezen!).
